The '''G61 Delta Wing''', also known as the '''Cularin Starfighter''', as a type of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that was used by the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The Delta Wing was designed for the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] in [[Edic Bar]] on [[Genarius]] by the designer [[Ryll Narbe]]. He designed it because he wanted to prove to his employers that he was still a credible designer, so he made it able to out perform the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] and the Corporation's own [[G-59 Cannibalizer]] line. However, they were expensive to build, so the Corporation decided not to mass-produce them. The few that were built were donated to the Cularin Militia, for use with their fleet.

The Militia used them during various battles, including the [[Battle of Cularin (21 BBY)|Battle of Cularin]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure [[Heart of Evil: Destruction|''Destruction'']], it is possible for some of the player characters to fly Delta Wings during a mission codenamed [[Destruction]].
